name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's sex is female at the current time.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's sex is documented as female at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's sex is documented as not female (i.e., male or other) at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_undergone_hysterectomy_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a hysterectomy procedure in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a hysterectomy procedure at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a hysterectomy procedure at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a hysterectomy procedure.

name: patient_is_able_to_be_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently able to become pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently able to become pregnant (e.g., has a uterus and is physiologically capable of pregnancy).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently unable to become pregnant (e.g., due to hysterectomy or other permanent infertility causes).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's ability to become pregnant is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
